definitions.explanation: Doing multiple things at the same time, or a process running simultaneously with another.

examples.japanese: {二|ふた}つの{作業|さぎょう}を{並行|へいこう}して{進|すす}めた。
examples.english: I worked on two tasks in parallel.

examples.japanese: {開発|かいはつ}とテストを{並行|へいこう}して{行|おこな}っている。
examples.english: Development and testing are being carried out concurrently.

examples.japanese: {本業|ほんぎょう}と{並行|へいこう}して、{副業|ふくぎょう}のウェブサイトも{運営|うんえい}している。
examples.english: Alongside my main job, I also run a side-business website.

notes:
USAGE:
{並行|へいこう}して is the て-form of {並行|へいこう}する (to run in parallel). It is used adverbially to describe simultaneous actions. The base noun {並行|へいこう} can also be used as a no-adjective: {並行|へいこう}の{作業|さぎょう} (parallel tasks).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ～と{並行|へいこう}して (alongside ~, in parallel with ~)
- {並行|へいこう}して{進|すす}める (to advance concurrently)
- {並行|へいこう}{輸入|ゆにゅう} (parallel import)
